chunks: Abu ʿAli al-Ashʿari, from Muhammad ibn ʿAbd al-Jabbar, from Safwan ibn Yahya, from Humran ibn Aʿyan, who said:
I said to Abu Jaʿfar عليه السلام: “What is the place of the scholars?” He said: “Like Dhu al-Qarnayn, and the companion of Sulayman, and the companion of Musa عليه السلام.”

key_terms.الْعُلَمَاءِ: the scholars; people of sacred knowledge
key_terms.ذِي الْقَرْنَيْنِ: Dhu al-Qarnayn, a renowned righteous figure from earlier history
key_terms.صَاحِبِ سُلَيْمَانَ: the companion of Sulayman عليه السلام
key_terms.صَاحِبِ مُوسَى: the companion of Musa عليه السلام

ai.seo_question: What does Imam Abu Jaʿfar عليه السلام say about the rank of the scholars?
ai.summary: This hadith asks about the rank and station of the scholars and answers by comparing them to exemplary figures from earlier sacred history. It indicates an elevated religious standing for such figures through analogy with divinely guided personalities associated with past prophets.
